archetypes.name: shell-fence
archetypes.rationale: Step 3.6 now depends on Bash rc capture, trailer splitting, and case routing rather than env parsing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the thin Step 3.6 orchestrator fence for Bash control-flow bugs, especially set -e interactions, command-substitution capture, rc branching, heredoc parsing, and exec pause handoff. Check that rc 0, 2, 10, 11, and catch-all paths preserve the intended /design lifecycle. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: trailer-spoofing
archetypes.rationale: The diff introduces trusted trailer parsing and untrusted assessor display neutralization as a security boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether untrusted assessor output, verdict files, or sidecar env data can spoof trusted trailer markers, leak parser-only lines into chat, or influence Stop-round control. Pay close attention to last-marker parsing, neutralization patterns, fixed-key sidecar reads, path confinement, and command-execution risks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: classification-gate
archetypes.rationale: Multiple scripts now key HARD/SIMPLE behavior off design_classification with fail-closed semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review classification resolution across the Step 3.6 fence, design-plan-quality-assessor.sh, assess-plan-round.sh, and design-postplan-emit.sh. Verify that missing, invalid, and workflow_path-mismatched run params consistently fail closed to HARD where required and skip only for true SIMPLE. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pause-resume
archetypes.rationale: The change alters pause-save step inference and Gate-B-bypass completion sentinels.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect pause/resume integration around Step 3, Step 3.5, Step 3.6, and Step 3b. Verify that completion sentinels, registry ordering, Gate-B-bypass paths, and rc=11 pause-save behavior cannot resume into skipped work or skip required work. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fd-contract
archetypes.rationale: The design shifts user-visible output to emit/FD 3 while stdout remains quiet-log data.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate the FD contract introduced for phase drivers and its implementation in the assessor path. Check that user-facing display, machine trailers, quiet-mode output, and stdout fallback behavior remain clearly separated across driver, orchestrator, and tests. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
